Name: Ecosystem Superpack Expansion
Author: cajcbell
Description:
[i][size=6][center][size=5]Version 1.6 now live! Many small bugs fixed, including turtle item errors, Ranger Taro pathing (mostly), some multiplayer crashes (hopefully), event and dialogue changes, etc.

Have you experienced weird tiles in front of the FIASA boat, and none of the previous updates have fixed it?? Do you also happen to have[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37301] Speedy Solutions [/url]﻿installed?
One of the ways to fix this issue is to delete the [b]Sub_enter entry[/b][b][/b] within Speedy Solutions [b]cache folder[/b]! Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Licalia]Licalia[/url]﻿ for finding this solution![/size][/center][/size][size=5]And finally - if you are looking for a full guide on the heart events and cutscenes in this mod, follow the link stickied on the comments page! [/size]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oIAR2fw.png[/img]

Explore desert canyons, forest meadows, and seaside coves. This expansion rewards exploring nature and solving puzzles, adding undertones that match the vanilla flavor of the game. It's meant to add a lot without adding a lot![/i]
[i]
[/i][left][b][size=3]ESE adds in total:[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][size=3]Just 3 full NPCs, one of which is romance-able, plus some side character cameos[/size]
[*][size=3]26 new events to see, some with and without NPCs[/size]
[*][size=3]5 new map areas, not including interior or special event areas[/size]
[*][size=3]Also not including 7 different versions of one map, with riddles and secrets![/size]
[*][size=3]2 new animals, one for the barn and one for the coop[/size]
[*][size=3]1 new crop[/size]
[*][size=3]3 tea recipes with all-day speed and boon effects[/size]
[*][size=3]2 new shops, and (after completing an NPC quest-line) an extra day for the Traveling Merchant[/size]
[/list][/left][center]
﻿﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/lrMrGbV.png[/img]﻿[/center]
[size=3]ESE is safe to install for fresh saves, mid-save, and even in saves that previously had FIASA, Ranger Taro, or the Canyons installed. See below for more details!
[/size][size=4]
[/size][center][size=5][b]﻿[b]﻿Delete all previous versions[i] [/i]of these mods before installing ESE.
[/b][/b]Unzip ESE directly into your Mods folder.
This NOT a regular update, and the files, folders, and code are completely different!
[b]DO NOT "Replace All" like you would with an update! [/b][/size][/center][size=3]
These mods are [b]Required[/b]:[/size]
[spoiler]﻿[list][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]
Content Patcher[/url]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]
Farm Type Manager[/url]﻿ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]
MMAP[/url]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36778]
Sharogg's Panoramas[/url]﻿ [/list][/spoiler]
[size=3]These mods are [b]Optional [/b]but add to the experience:[/size]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12831]Dynamic Reflections[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30514]Moonlight Jellies Guitar cover[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15860]Like a Duck to Water[/url]﻿ [i]*The coop Turtles will swim like ducks, and are effected by this mod. Note, if you use Alternative Textures, both ducks and ESE turtles will walk on the water instead. That is an AT issue, even if you do not use AT on the individual animal.[/i]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36681]Flamingos[/url]﻿ *[i]and, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39857]Em's Flamingo[/url]﻿ option[/i]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8410]Donkeys[/url]﻿ [i]*And, the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35393]CC-stye replacement[/url]﻿[/i]
[/list][/spoiler][b][size=3]
[/size][/b][size=3]If you previously had Ranger Taro, FIASA, or Canyons installed, [b]have deleted those folders, [/b]and freshly installed ESE...
[b]Here's what to expect:[/b][/size]
[spoiler]
[list][list]
[*][size=3]The SMAPI log will give you some yellow warnings about missing locations and NPCs. This is the game clearing all the old maps from the old versions - it will only happen on your first load of the save after install. It is completely safe.[/size]
[*][size=3]You will keep almost all your items from the Canyons; two teas will become error items. Trash those.[/size]
[*][size=3]Relationships, and event progress with NPCs will be reset completely. [/size]
[*][size=3][b]This means you may want to divorce Koda before a fresh install, if you married her before![/b][/size]
[*][size=3]NPCs may stand around weirdly on the first day. They will start their normal schedules the next day.[/size]
[/list][/list][/spoiler]
[center]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/zVA7jVu.png[/img][/center]

[size=3]There are several options in the config, but [b]you only need to worry about the first two.[/b]
[/size]
[size=3]There is an option to choose Portraits, either for Vanilla or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu-style[/url], already built in.

There is an option for the Traveling Merchant, built-in.[/size][list]
[*][size=3][b]Suki [/b]is the version of the Merchant consistent with SVE and Portraits for Vendors[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Lotti [/b]is the version of the Merchant consistent with Visit Mount Vapius[/size]
[/list][size=3]
Please note - whichever version you choose will only effect the Merchant in ESE, who is (secretly) coded to be standalone from the actual Merchant in the vanilla game. That means the option you choose is about whichever [b]matches the consistency of your own game. [/b]For example, if you play with both SVE and VMV, but you prefer Lotti, then choosing Lotti in this mod will make her match during cutscenes.[/size]

[size=4][b][center]All configs beyond these two options SHOULD NOT BE CHANGED. But also don't panic if you do, just reset them to their defaults :)[/center]
[/b][/size][size=3]These options are related to MMAP, and will be folded into the internal code in a future update.[/size][size=4]
[/size][center]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Flv0CHj.png[/img][/center]
[size=3][i]
It probably wasn't necessary to list all of these compatible mods, as they encompass much of the SDV expansion and custom NPC meta. But, every single one was playtested with ESE! So maybe this list can also stand as a showcase of some cool modding content you might want to check out. [/i]

Please note - [b]Just because all of these mods are compatible with ESE, doesn't mean they are all compatible with each other!
[/b]Also, I have not been able to test multiplayer play! Please report any bugs you find in multiplayer!

[b][size=4]Translators:
[/size][/b]
You have my explicit permission to translate into any language! :)
However!
You may notice that the i18n is... empty.... 

I'm so sorry! I have a hard time coding with the i18n, so I left it to the very end, and forgot to use the i18n-ifier before uploading the file! 
[b]I will be fix this in a future update.[/b]
[b][size=4]
Portraits:
[/size][/b]
You have my permission to make and edit character portraits! Especially if it's for your custom use. If it's to match another visual style (like Leyalluna or talkohlooey), feel free to publish it as long as you add ESE as a requirement so that it is linked through nexus.

[b][size=4]Uploads:
[/size][/b]
The places, characters, and stories in this mod are close to my heart. I put care, love, and many hours of work into ESE. Please do not attempt to reupload and take credit for this work on another platform. 
[i]
[/i][size=4][b]Credits:
[/b][/size]
I grew up in southern AZ. The entire Canyon pack was inspired by my childhood out in the desert. I went to college in MT, in glacial mountains... and got to know the forest as well. I currently live with my beautiful wife in the PNW, by the sea. So in part this expansion is just me modding in what I love, to a game I love.

Forever thank you to [url=https://discord.gg/stardewvalley]SDV Discord[/url], which has the most amazing and active community dedicated to modding.

Now on to the thick of it!
